item.title: Channel 1
item.description: Channel 1 was a Bangladeshi Bengali-language satellite TV channel launched on 24 January 2006. It was owned by One Entertainment Limited and broadcast entertainment and news programs for all ages. The channel was founded by Giasuddin Al Mamun, though he claimed it had no political links.
